name: Mizuha Izuru
source:
Hobbies: Buying weird stamps, spending money
Liked food: Pizza, pasta
Disliked food: Lots of things; has a very unbalanced diet

[url=/c83260]Youta's[/url] odd classmate whose favorite catchphrase is "this is so annoying." Aside from her listed hobbies, she also loves sleeping, and often skips classes. After learning about [url=/c83261]Touko[/url] taking on correspondence courses, she moves into the mansion, and thanks to Touko's wealth, is able to spend more money on her games.
Ever since moving into the mansion, she's started teasing [url=/c83263]Yoru[/url] more, while the latter sees Izuru as her enemy.
